scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names BACKEND,FRONTEND --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run preview --workspace frontend -- --host 0.0.0.0"
